item.title: 1964 Plymouth Sport Fury Convertible 383 3-Speed
item.description: This 1964 Plymouth Sport Fury convertible was refurbished circa 2010 while under the previous ownership of car builder and drag racer Jim Hale of Van Buren, Arkansas. Powered by a 383ci Commando V8 linked with a column-shifted three-speed manual transmission, the car is finished in red with a white soft top over a red and white interior. item.title: 786-Mile 2023 Maserati MC20 Cielo

item.description: This 1987 Mercedes-Benz 190E 2.3-16 spent time in Illinois and Indiana before the selling dealer's purchase in 2018, and it now shows 54k miles. item.description: This '32 Ford Highboy Roadster is a hot rod that was assembled under previous ownership with a Brookville steel body over a 1932 Ford-style frame and it was purchased by the current owner on BaT in December 2019. Finished in brown over tan vinyl, the car is powered by a Buick Fireball 401ci V8 linked with a TCI Auto three-speed automatic transmission and a Winters Performance quick-change rear end. item.title: This Week’s Weird and Wonderful—January 16, 2026
item.description: It's been a big week! We just wrapped up the 2025 BaT Awards, and now we're here to send you into the weekend with another installment of the Weekly Weird and Wonderful. Below, you will find a tightly curated selection showing a few of what we have subjectively determined to be the most interesting vehicles on BaT this week. We hope you enjoy it, and as always, there's plenty more to explore on our Live Auctions page.

item.title: 1998 Subaru Impreza 22B STi
item.description: This 1998 Subaru Impreza 22B STi is #388 of 400 examples produced for the Japanese market to commemorate Subaru’s 40th anniversary and their manufacturer’s titles in the World Rally Championship race series. Chassis 071667 was sold new in Japan before being relocated to the UK circa 2002 and later appeared on the cover of the November 2024 issue of evo magazine before being brought to the US in 2024.
